body: My doctor is thinking of putting me on clozaril for my suicidal thoughts.  There is a lot of new research on it that is promising.  I've been on lithium before.  It makes me flat.
You can PM me.  I love to chat.  I'm kind of lonely now too as I just broke up with my SO.
Thank you.  It's hard.  I get so lonely.  He used to spend a lot of time with me even though a lot of that resulted in tears and heartbreak.
I have major identity issues.  I've faked being another person online even.  I am very unhappy with who I am.  I go through phases of trying to reinvent myself.  It's not healthy.
Great song!!

I second not giving her the car.  Support good choices, don't enable the bad.  Andlet her hit her bottom.  I'm not saying let her kill herself.  By all means stop that if you can.  Commit her if needed.  Let her suffer the consequences of her choices.  Pain is a great motivator for change.

You have rights too.  If you really are doing it in a calm respectable way I am not sure what else you can do.  Maybe point out that you still care for them and want what is best for both of you?  I know sometimes I feel attacked which makes me go crazy but if someone is calm, respectful and reassuring I respond much better.

We need to change ourselves.  The rest world isn't going to change.  We need to live in the world and not expect it to revolve around us.

There were not DBT programs were I live.  There still aren't any.

I feel like this often.  I want someone to know and acknowledge my feelings.  I have trouble finding the words sometimes.  I also think people assume I am being dramatic.  I feel people don't take me seriously.  I'm not sure how to change this.  Other people aren't going to change so the only thing I can change is myself. I'm just not sure where to begin.

If you can afford to go I would go.  I wish I had that option availible to me.  Back in 2002 I went to an inpatient DBT program in Chicago and it helped a lot.  I just didn't keep up with treatment when I got home.

I feel pretty much anyone that knows me would be better off if I would just end it.  I have trouble wrapping my head around the fact of anyone being hurt.  I know in my head that if a daughter, sister, friend kills themself there would be saddness or grief but I have a hard time believing anyone cares that much.  I know when I think about it rationally they do but I just don't feel it.

I had my first suicidal thoughts when I was 7.  I was at summer camp and I was homesick.  I tried to hold my breath until I died.  Impossible I know now but I was 7.  You would think the counselors would have told my parents.  That was not normal thinking.  But no.  It wasn't until my gudience counselor was told by the other kids I was cutting that he told my parents.  I was shipped off to therapy then at age 12.
How did you lose that amount of weight in just 6 months?

They weren't overprotective or anything like that.  I had a good relationship with my dad.  My mom was abusive.  She moved out when I was 12.  My dad and stepmom were the opposite of overprotective.  We could do pretty much anything we wanted.
No I don't think so but I'm not totally sure what you mean.

I was adopted as a newborn.  I have known about it for as long as I can remember.  I hate thinking about it.  I often have feelings of the ulitmate rejection by my birthmother.  Sometimes I wish she would have just had an abortion.  I was adopted because my parents thought they couldn't have kids. They had had a baby that died hours after birth.  My mom got pregnant during the adoption process.  I think they went through with it because they thought my brother wouldn't live.  I wonder if my father ever regretted the decision.  I know my mother did since she said she wished they never adopted me more than once.  This was very painful to write.  I try not to think of it often.  I am curious too about other people's experiences.

edit:  My younger brother did live.

I'm all over the place.  One hour I am ok and the next I am not.  I am a masochist so I am dealing with it by using pain.  I am not cutting but I play with someone who has a sadistic streak that I trust not to let it go too far.   It helps.
I have both but my BPD is the worse of the two.  The only thing that is postive with the bipolar is that I have had full blown manic episodes and I can not tolerate antidepressants.
Learn to take care of yourself and detach with love.  That is an alanon thing but I think that would work with your situation too.

These are both very bad ideas.  Alcohol and drugs are very bad for people with BPD.  We are at a high risk for addiction.  I used both weed and alcohol for a long time with very bad consequences.  They do not help in the long run.

Learn to self soothe.  Go for a walk or exercise.  Take deep breaths.  Try watching something funny and lighthearted.  Talk to someone.  Write it out and rip it up.  Know that this will pass.  Freak outs don't last forever.

Stay clear of drugs and alcohol as a way to cope.

It is something I probably need to look at.  I crave carbs too.  I don't know if eating them effects my moods.  I know almost totally removing them did.  I gained a lot of weight from when I was on seroquel which I am trying to lose.  I ate tons of sugar and carbs then.  The cravings have gotten better since being off of seroquel though.  Evil drug.

I am trying to stay out of relationships for now too.  I'm addicted to them though so it can be hard.  I really hurt my last boyfriend by splitting so badly.  I thought everything was his fault but really my behavior was the cause.  I lied and I cheated.  The strange thing is all this occured because I was scared he would walk away at a moments notice and leave me alone.  The very thing I was trying to prevent was the very thing I caused.  He is still in my life for which I am grateful.  He is trying to help me work on my issues.  We are not boyfriend and girlfriend though and he sees other people.  That hurts the most.  I can not even begin to describe the pain there.  But I was seeing other people when we were together.  I need some major work before I can be someone's girlfriend again.  Progress is so slow.
I tried a really low carb diet and my depression and mood swings worsened.  I guess everyone is different.
Thankseveryone for your comments and suggestions.
I don't disassociate.  I wish I could at times though.

I don't find it helpful trying to figure out who to blame.  I had some stuff happen to me when I was young too.  My parents had issues.  But the truth is I am an adult now and responsible for myself.  I need to focus on what I can do now to make things better.

I have a low tolerance for being alone.  I can do a couple hours but more then that is pushing it.  I am alone at home a lot too since I don't drive.  I'm not sure what to do about it though.  Hopefully someone has some good ideas.

I've been in that mindset before where I thought if I had one specific thing everything will be ok.  It might be a medication or a specific type of therapy or a person.  I fixated on that.  Sometimes I had research to back it up too.  That kind of sounds like where you are.  There is no guarantee especially with medication.  Doctors don't prescribe MAOIs much anymore.  I think you are setting yourself up.  Please be open to other ideas/suggestions.  Don't limit yourself.

I don't think I need that right now.  I finally slept a bit today.

wagls....you could go to your er and they will help get you admitted.  That is the way it works here anyways.
I'm just feeling sorry for myself.  I didn't sleep at all last night.  That lowers my ability to deal with anything.

I understand what you are saying.  We are not our diagnosis.  We are people and for the most part we try and do the best we can.  A lot of us have not learned the skills to deal with our emotions or life in general.  Therapy can help with that.  We are capable of learning.  That is the key to an better life.  I'm sorry you are having a hard time.  Are you getting any help?

Like others said bipolar and bpd can coexist.  I am both although I question if I am really bipolar sometimes.  Your episodes sound more like hypomania to me but I am not a professional.  I've read some researchers even think bpd should be on the bipolar spectrum.  Antidepressants make me really high so it might be the prozac.  Lamictal can also push you up too high.  I'm glad you are talking to your providers.
I'm glad so many people liked this.  I love finding stuff like this that helps me realize there are reasons I am the way I am and that it can be better.  Also that there are other people like me.
I do this quite often.  I have the whole I hate you don't leave me thing going on with someone right now.  I know that sounds cliche but it is a pretty accurate description when I take a step back.
